page0.text:
I run up the stairs.
Rider and Shinji are on the third floor.
I can tell Shinji's still on the third floor because of the way my Command Spells are reacting.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page0:1

page1.text:
The moment I set foot on the third floor, sparks fly.
"Is that Rider!?"
I couldn't see, but Saber must have parried Rider's attempt at a sneak attack from above.
"Shirou. I will defeat Rider.
Please take care of Rider's Master...!"
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page1:1

page2.text:
She doesn't need to tell me.
Saber can't possibly lose to Rider. She won't.
I'm absolutely sure after what little I was able to learn of Rider's abilities during my brief fight with her.
Saber's abilities vastly exceed Rider's.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page2:1

page3.text:
"I'm leaving her up to you! But try not to go too far. It'll be over soon once I stop Shinji!"
I run right past Saber.
That same instant, Rider flings a dagger at me with murderous intent, but Saber rushes in to deflect the attack!
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page3:1

page4.text:
I run down the hallway.
Ahead, I see a bewildered Shinji.
"Guess I'll be at a disadvantage if go at him empty-handed!"
I need a weapon. It should be long...like the mop leaning against the locker there!
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page4:1

page5.text:
"Trace...on."
I pass magical energy through my body as I run.
Maybe I'm not distracted, or maybe I just can't afford to think of anything else...
I manage to Strengthen the plastic mop as effortlessly as breathing.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page5:1

page6.text:
The shadows begin forming again.
I'm badly injured, but I don't feel the least bit sluggish.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page6:1

page7.text:
More than that, I have a weapon now.
That means...
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page7:1

page8.text:
...I don't even need to dodge.
I use the mop to smack aside each shadow as it flies toward me.
The mop breaks, but I expected as much from something done so hastily.
Besides, I don't need it anymore. I'm so close!
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page8:1

page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page9:1

page10.text:
I lash out with a furious punch.
The impact jars my arm, which is still practically cut to ribbons, so painfully that I nearly pass out.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page10:1

page11.text:
I punch Shinji in the stomach, and then grab him and shove him against the wall.
"Kngh...you...!"
Shinji tries to shove my hand away.
Without missing a beat, I kick his grasping arm.
I can't even control myself right now.
I slam the arm I kicked against the wall...and break it.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page11:1

page12.text:
"Ah...ggh...AAAHHHH!!!"
I don't even hear Shinji's screams.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page12:1

page13.text:
"Ngh...! Hngh!"
This is bad.
If I don't focus, it might be me who faints.
I should hurry while I can still move.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page13:1

page14.text:
"Ahh!"
I grab Shinji's hair and smash him against the wall.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page14:1

page15.text:
"Scream later. Release the Bounded Field, Shinji."
"Th-the hell I will...who're you to tell me..."
I grab Shinji by the throat with the arm I can still control.
Blood pours from my arm.
It seeps through my clothes and it drips onto Shinji's body, staining him.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page15:1

page16.text:
"If you won't shut off the Bounded Field, then I just have to kill you. I don't care which it is, so pick one. Now."
I squeeze.
It must be all the magical energy coursing through my body...
I could snap his neck like a twig.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page16:1

page17.text:
"Ha. You're bluffing. You couldn't do something like that. B-besides, I haven't killed anyone yet. I was just borrowing a little bit of life from everyone..."
"Okay then. Bye, Shinji."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page17:1

page18.text:
I squeeze harder.
There's no hesitation.
Maybe a little sympathy.
I feel bad that as a fellow mage, Shinji was never taught the rules of being a mage...and so didn't have any problem killing innocents.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page18:1

page19.text:
"W-wait! Hold up! You beat me, Emiya! I'll stop the Bounded Field...I promise!"
"..."
I loosen my grip around his throat.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page19:1

page20.text:
"...Hah...hah...haaa...damn! You're crazy strong. Hey Rider! Stop your Blood Fort!
Your Master's life's in danger!"
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page20:1

page21.text:
...
There's no response from Rider.
But hearing Shinji, Saber takes a step back from Rider.
Rider lowers her dagger. I see her mouth move.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page21:1

page22.text:
"This is what you want, right? I hear this Bounded Field is special, since it's hard to reconstruct another one in the same place.
So there won't be another Bounded Field here again. Now take your damn hands off of me."
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page22:1

page23.text: "That's not how this works. I won, so you do what I say. Shinji, get rid of your Command Spells. Then we'll never have to fight again."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page23:1

page24.text: "Wha... That's ridiculous! I'm not doing that! If I get rid of my Command Spells, I won't be able to control Rider. If that happens, I—"
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page24:1

page25.text:
"You won't be a Master anymore. Then you go to the church in Shinto. I hear they protect Masters who drop out of the war.
Or is it something else? Were you lying when you said you made a Bounded Field to protect yourself?"
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page25:1

page26.text:
"I-I didn't say that. I just thought if I became a Master and controlled a Servant..."
...He thought he could be a mage.
But what's the point of becoming one?
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page26:1

page27.text:
"It's over, Shinji. If you're not going to get rid of your Command Spells, I'll just have to cut them out."
"Eh? Cut them...out?"
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page27:1

page28.text:
Shinji tilts his head in genuine wonderment.
This isn't an act. Shinji really doesn't know what I'm talking about.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page28:1

page29.text:
"Well, you see..."
"Shirou, get back!!!"
I hear Saber's shout.
Maybe it's all the training at the dojo...but my body reacts to Saber's words before my brain processes them.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page29:1

page30.text:
I let go of Shinji and jump back.
At the moment, Rider's dagger swings through the spot I'd been standing in a heartbeat before.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page30:1

page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page31:1

page32.text: "Shirou, please step back! Rider intends to unleash all the magical energy she used to maintain the Bounded Field!"
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page32:1

page33.text:
"What!? Unleash the magical energy!?"
I look towards Rider. She does seem odd.
The way she just appeared here when she'd been confronting Saber a second ago, the cold air emanating from her... Everything about her is suddenly far more intimidating than she has ever been.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page33:1

page34.text: "R-Rider!? What the hell are you thinking? You can't even beat Emiya's Servant, so why are you taking the reins!?"
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page34:1

page35.text:
"Correct. I am no match for Saber.
However, please be assured: my Noble Phantasm is greater than any of the other Servants'. No matter the opponent, they cannot match my agility."
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page35:1

page36.text:
Rider raises her dagger.
"Wha..."
Everyone gasps in surprise.
For some reason, Rider presses her dagger to her neck and...
...slashes her own throat.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page36:1

page37.text:
Red sprays everywhere.
Blood gushes from the black-clad Rider's pale neck.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page37:1

page38.text:
"Wha...what are you...?"
Shinji is just as surprised as the rest of us.
No matter how extraordinary Servants may be, a slashed throat is fatal.
Rider will bleed out and disappear on her own.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page38:1

page39.text:
"Gh—!?"
The splattered blood stops mid-air and slowly forms into a circle.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page39:1

page40.text:
...a magic circle, drawn in blood.
It's a pattern I've never seen before.
The design resembles a creature...an ominous creature.
Rider's created a giant lump of magical energy.
The Bounded Field from earlier seems like child's play compared to this magic circle.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page40:1

page41.text:
"Wha...!? I'm being pushed back...!"
This must be a truly massive amount of magical energy.
I'm being pushed back as if by a strong wind.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page41:1

page42.text:
"Shirou, get away! Rider intends to use her Noble Phantasm. If you don't move, you'll be caught in it!"
Saber grabs me and jerks me back.
She faces down Rider and her magic circle as she protects me.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page42:1

page43.text:
"Do you intend to run, Rider?
If you are going to drag your Master into this, I need only defeat you here. I will not allow you to use your Noble Phantasm."
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page43:1

page44.text:
"Fufu. Of course not. A Servant's duty is to protect her Master. I am just taking Master and running.
If you do not like that, come after us, Saber."
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page44:1

page45.text: "If, that is, you still have the will to fight after seeing this."
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page45:1

page46.text:
A throbbing sound pulses through the school.
With the sound of rending flesh, Rider's hair whirls around her.
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page46:1

page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page47:1

page48.text:
Saber tugs my hand and drags me to the ground.
There's a roar and then a flash.
I close my eyes against the raging wind.
But even with my eyes closed, I still feel its intensity.
Something white streaks by.
A huge bolt of light shoots down the hallway at tremendous speed.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page48:1

page49.text:
...
All I see before me is dreadful destruction.
Shinji and Rider are gone.
The bolt of light wasn't after us. It was probably a means of escape.
"...Ng."
My wounds hurt.
I feel a hammering in my head again.
The heat flowing through my body quickly fades.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-12:page49:1
